locked_product_direction.proposal_purpose: Venue presents eligible commercial choices; client selects; client approval confirms that selection.
locked_product_direction.skip_path: If client already knows what they want, venue skips Proposal and goes direct to Contract.
locked_product_direction.convergence: Both paths must share the same frozen commercial source of truth for Contract → sign → deposit/Stripe.

verdict.summary: Today's Proposal is a shareable rubber-stamp of a venue-chosen single package. The target Proposal is a multi-option commercial menu where the client selects and HTC freezes that choice. Direct-to-contract already converges on commercial_selections; the gap is the client-choice Proposal layer and catalog eligibility.
safe_to_build_on: createContract merge from selection → contracts.content freeze
setupPaymentsFromSelection copying selection amounts into invoice/schedule
Select Package without offer (direct commercial decision)
must_not_conflate: Library package live price ≠ accepted commercial total
proposal accepted ≠ booked / signed / deposit paid
Event Order lines ≠ commercial_selections (fallback merge only)

live_fixture_jane_smith.name: Signature Wedding
live_fixture_jane_smith.observation: Venue picked Signature Wedding; client Accept proposal only flipped offered→accepted. No client package choice UI existed.

eligibility.notes: SelectPackageSheet filters only is_active && base_price > 0. category is freeform label, not a rules engine. Lead event_type / guest_count / planned_event_space_id exist elsewhere but are not wired to packages.

proposal_as_implemented.cardinality: one active selection per lead/client (prior superseded on replace)

fields.source_package_id: nullable FK to packages (provenance only; not live-bound)
fields.name: frozen package name at create
fields.accepted_at: when client or venue marks accepted
fields.contract_id: set when contract created from selection
fields.invoice_id: set when payments setup from selection

capability_matrix.proposal_version_snapshot: partial — selection.version + frozen fields; not a multi-option offer snapshot
capability_matrix.client_approval_timestamp: partial — accepted_at only (selection and approval are the same event today)

client_experience.behavior: Binary confirm of venue-chosen package. No choose/compare/qty/add-on.

venue_create_path.freeze_moment: at venue create (not at client accept)
venue_create_path.copy: Changing the Library package later will not change it.

proposal_accepted_semantics_today.notification: create_venue_notification type=proposal_accepted; bell CTA Open the relationship
proposal_accepted_semantics_today.journey_copy: They accepted the proposal. This venue still requires a signed contract. The proposal is not a contract, and they are not booked.

proposal_to_contract.relationship: selection.contract_id FK after createContract with selectionId
proposal_to_contract.fallback_if_no_selection: Event Order package/custom lines (weaker; names only for package section)
proposal_to_contract.post_create: contracts.content is frozen text; later Library edits do not rewrite signed/draft contract body
proposal_to_contract.re_merge_on_edit: not automatic from live catalog; new version / amend is separate contract lineage

direct_to_contract_today.path: Select Package (draft) → Create contract (?selectionId=…) without Send proposal
direct_to_contract_today.note: Direct path already skips offer/accept. Gap vs target is only that venue must still pick the one package; there is no client-menu Proposal.

payments_convergence.invoice: commitment invoice created from those amounts (not re-priced from Library)
payments_convergence.conflict_with_target: none on money SoT once selection is frozen; paused EMAIL-32K is presentation, not model

entities.package_catalog: Mutable Library (packages + future eligibility + priced add-ons).
entities.proposal: Offer container: which eligible options are presented to this lead, with prices frozen at send.
entities.accepted_commercial_selection: Immutable chosen lines + calculated total + deposit — today's commercial_selections role after client approval (or venue direct decision).
entities.contract: Legal document merged from accepted selection snapshot into frozen content.
entities.invoice_schedule: Money plan derived from accepted selection amounts.

target_journey: Venue selects all eligible package/options available for this client
Contract generated from that exact selection
alternative_path: Venue already knows selection → create commercial_selection (draft/accepted-by-venue)

proposal_accepted_should_mean.database: Client-approved commercial choice frozen (chosen package/options/qty/add-ons + calculated total). Distinct from prior client_selected_at if multi-step UX.
proposal_accepted_should_mean.activity_notification: Still proposal_accepted (or rename to commercial_selection_approved) — still must NOT mean booked/signed/paid.
proposal_accepted_should_mean.downstream_gate: Unlocks Create contract from frozen selection; does not auto-create contract unless product later chooses to.

recommendation.L0_catalog: packages / package_items / future eligibility rules — always mutable
recommendation.L1_offer_snapshot: NEW — freeze eligible options + unit prices at Send proposal (so catalog edits cannot change what the client was shown)
recommendation.L2_accepted_selection: commercial_selections (or successor) — freeze chosen lines + totals at client approval OR venue direct-decide
recommendation.L3_contract_content: contracts.content — freeze merged legal text at contract create / lock on send-sign
recommendation.L4_money: invoices + payment_schedules — copy amounts from L2; never re-read Library

today.L2: created at venue Select Package (too early for target client-choice journey)

migration_implications.existing_rows: Accepted single-package commercial_selections (e.g. Jane Signature Wedding) remain valid L2 snapshots for Contract/Payments. Treat as venue-decided or already-approved commercial.
migration_implications.backward_compatible_strategy: Keep commercial_selections as L2 SoT. Add L1 Proposal/options alongside. Migrate offered+accepted rows as proposals with one option already chosen.
breaking_risks: Changing accept_commercial_selection to require a prior client choice breaks existing offered links that expect one-click accept
Moving freeze timing from create→approve changes totals if Library price drifted after Select Package
Renaming proposal_accepted notification type breaks bell mapping unless dual-written
migration_implications.non_goals_this_phase: Do not rewrite payment email, Stripe Connect, or contract signing in the same change set.

conflicts_with_booking_contract_payment.booking: No conflict — accept already documented as not booked; target keeps that.
conflicts_with_booking_contract_payment.contract: Compatible if Contract always reads L2 selection; conflict only if Proposal generate-contract before approval.
conflicts_with_booking_contract_payment.payment: Compatible if invoice continues from L2 amounts; conflict if deposit UI invents totals independent of selection.
conflicts_with_booking_contract_payment.event_order: Soft conflict — dual commercial narrative when selection absent; target should prefer L2 always for commercial contracts.
conflicts_with_booking_contract_payment.process_order_prefs: deposit_first vs agreement_first still apply after L2 exists; Proposal layer sits before both.

recommended_build_order_when_unpaused: 1. Define L1 Proposal + options schema; keep commercial_selections as L2
2. Freeze L1 prices on send; client choose → write L2; accept = approve L2
3. Wire eligibility resolver (even if rules v1 = active+priced only)
4. Keep Create contract + setupPayments reading only L2
5. Direct-to-contract = venue writes L2 without L1
6. Then payment email / Stripe journey fixes (paused)
